output.text: {"notes":["World coordinates are right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; the requested forward position and velocity are world-frame quantities in m and m/s.","The zero-velocity brake is scheduled from t=0.4714 s through t=2.0 s, with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m at each axle.","The controller is evaluated before every 0.0001 s integration step, and scheduled events use half-open intervals [start,end).","stopped_by_T is true only if absolute forward speed is below 0.02 m/s and planar speed is below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
